new_slide_text: RK-03 | RiboMIMO Clean Tables Pass Independent Recompute
4 fixed author matrices · E. coli + S. cerevisiae · strict coverage and reference-protein QC
Production all-QC and clean tables · independently recomputed
Mohammad19 paired clean n=1,385 | Pearson median 0.6146 | Spearman median 0.5835 | total-count correlation 0.9837
BOUNDARY | processed A-site counts; no raw-read remapping or UTRs | mechanism QC only
The four RiboMIMO matrices contain 15,669 author-processed codon-level records, and 8,109 records pass every production clean gate.
Independent raw-source recomputation confirms every clean identifier, exclusion reason, normalized density and translated-reference match across all datasets.
For the 1,385 paired records clean in both Mohammad19 samples, the median profile Pearson is 0.6146 and Spearman is 0.5835; this is a reproducibility diagnostic, not a performance benchmark.
The source does not contain raw reads or UTRs, so no independent P-site remapping, functional-training authorization or OOD conclusion is claimed.
